options.content: Panels → **EPEVER XTRA3210N** → 12.8 V LiFePO4 bank (2 x 100 Ah, 2.56 kWh) → **LOAD** → Anker SOLIX → the shed HP micro. The rpi4 runs [epsolar](https://github.com/mitchross/epsolar): Modbus telemetry, these metrics and the guarded LOAD automation. Decision reasons live in the [Solar Buffer Control UI](http://192.168.10.174:8080), not in Prometheus. Nothing here costs money.
